newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish H1 industrial production up 7.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Turkish H1 industrial production up 7.5 percent.

text.p: Turkish industrial production rose 7.5 percent in the first half from a year earlier, the State Statistics Institute said in a statement.
In June, industrial production climbed 9.8 percent from the same 1996 month.
The mining sector shrank 0.8 percent in the first half compared to a year earlier, while the manufacturing sector showed a rise of 7.6 percent.
In the manufacturing sector, machinery achieved the strongest gains, rising 30.5 percent during the six month period. The textile sector shrank 3.2 percent on the same comparison.
The electric, gas and water sector grew 9.1 percent during the first half.
